scope: Read-only breakdown of the live durable tennis point-refresh queue and match-lookup queue
interpretation: Waiting for indexed player history or missing source player IDs accounts for 2,628 of 2,951 point jobs; browser slot count does not resolve this wait directly.
There are 218 retry jobs; 128 carry the legacy unmatched reason and are not currently consuming a browser slot.

One SQL aggregation split by status/last_error totals 2,952 point jobs; the immediately preceding standalone total was 2,951, showing one row changed during the live census. Only one point job and one match-lookup job were running in the grouped capture. This is a point-in-time queue census, not a throughput soak.
